title: 叫板“国产洋品牌”：浅析GIRDER格拉德Vagrant公路车
notes: 2016-10-19 article about the aluminium Vagrant road bike. Its byline and source field both read 'GIRDER格拉德', so its description of GIRDER as a domestic brand (国产品牌) that does not advertise foreign lineage is brand-contributed copy, not an independent classification. A reader comment repeats the 1977 Edinburgh/Manchester story and a 2014 licensing to 苏州格拉德自行车科技有限公司; that comment is unverified. The article does not cover Arrow.
